## Iris plot

Let's make a plot for length and width of sepal in iris data!

```{r iris}
library(plotly)

plot_ly(
  iris,
  x = ~Sepal.Length,
  y = ~Sepal.Width,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers"
)
```
